description: Find geo.admin features on one ech MapServer layer by an attribute value. Identify a point first if you need the attribute names. Example: layer ch.swisstopo.swissboundaries3d-gemeinde-flaeche.fill, search_field gemname, search_text Bern.

contains.description: When true (default), match values that contain the text. When false, match the whole value.

include_historical.description: Keep historical versions when a layer has an is_current_jahr attribute (default false).

search_field.description: Attribute name to search (e.g. gemname, name, label).

name: find_map_features
